verdict.rationale: CloudConvert documents its own ability to execute custom ffmpeg commands, which implies audio/video transcoding with control over codec, bitrate and resolution. That control is reached through a raw ffmpeg command rather than documented conversion options. The pack has no first-party description of audio/video format conversion or named codec/bitrate/resolution parameters. missing for 10: documented audio/video conversion task and supported format list, explicit codec/bitrate/resolution options, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, audio and video transcode between formats with control over codec, bitrate, and resolution

citations.quote: Execute custom ffmpeg, imagemagick, and graphicsmagick commands.
